LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.label: <color=#FF7A45>Life Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.description: Hostile burn inflicted by Mingyuan. It drains needs, accelerates aging, deals true damage, weakens stats, and bursts into a single large burn hit when the threshold is reached. If the target dies, Life Burn spreads to nearby enemies.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.stages.0.label: <color=#FF7A45>Life Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.label: <color=#FFB25C>Self Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.description: Beneficial burn counter. It boosts damage, movement, attack speed, work speed, shield regeneration, and Life Burn stacking.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.stages.0.label: <color=#FFB25C>Self Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.label: <color=#FFD37A>Burning Body</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.description: Mingyuan's otherworld-forged body: extreme part health, increased consciousness, heat and blast conversion, counterburn, periodic repair, and short invulnerability after taking damage.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.stages.0.label: <color=#FFD37A>Burning Body</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.label: <color=#FFE0A3>Protective Flame Shield</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.descri: Flame shield with 200 energy. It absorbs small, large, and lethal hits, regenerates automatically, rebuilds after breaking, and clears some hostile control states on hit.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Rebirth Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.description: Mingyuan's death-rebirth logic. On death, she detonates, resurrects, and enters Eternal Burning for 30 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.label: <color=#FF2E1F>Eternal Burning</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.description: Temporary rebirth lock. Damage and ticking are blocked until the rebirth process ends.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurnFrozen.label: <color=#C95CFF>Time Burn Frozen</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurnFrozen.description: Marker hediff used by Time Burn while a pawn's ticks are stopped.
